thread:
sam (AE): Heads-up: Vertex POC ready to sign. Procurement returned an MSA + DPA with SLA credit tweaks and an audit removal. They want e-sign same-day. Need routing and risk call.
nina (SE): Are SLA changes material? What did they adjust on response/availability credits?
sam (AE): They softened availability credit from 5% to 2% and added a 120h response for severity1. Procurement wants that accepted to speed things up.
hong (Legal): 120h for Sev1 is unacceptable. We generally require 4-8h for Sev1. Also they removed audit clause and added pseudo-SCCs language. Need to see exact redline.
procure-bot: Attachment uploaded: "Vertex_MSA_DPA_redline_v2.pdf" by alex at 2025-11-12 11:12
alex (Finance): Finance is fine to approve up to $30k ARR. Above that needs CFO. They also want net60; we prefer net30. Any flexibility?
sam (AE): Customer insists net60; procurement says they'll push net60 in PO only. They want orderform signed first and MSA/DPA to follow.
hong (Legal): Orderform-only signing again. We can allow temporary POC access if we add an OF clause: "POC provisioning contingent on executed DPA within 21 days; otherwise account paused." Also insist on audit right restoration and reasonable Sev1 SLA.
nina (SE): On provisioning: we can create a sandbox with synthetic/masked data and rate-limited seats. No exports, and no integrations until DPA signed. That should be acceptable for POC.
alex (Finance): If OF signs and MSA later, revenue recognition teams need the DPA before provisioning. We should include a billing hold clause until DPA executes.
hong (Legal): I'll draft two redlines: 1) short OF clause for conditional provisioning + billing hold, 2) restore audit and 8h Sev1 response. Will also propose SCC-compatible language rather than their ad-hoc text.
sam (AE): Great. Also customer asked for e-sign route: they want exec -> us. Procurement prefers legal -> finance -> AE -> exec. What's the fastest?
alex (Finance): Fastest is legal first so we don't sign bad terms. If customer pushes, we can keep legal as automatic reviewer in DocuSign with timestamped comments.
hong (Legal): Agree legal first. If the customer will only sign exec-first, escalate to CRO for approval.
procure-bot: DocuSign envelope created: env_7b9c3; route set to hong -> alex -> sam -> vertex-exec@vertex.com
sam (AE): Ping me when redline is uploaded. I'll coordinate with customer to accept masked-data sandbox.
hong (Legal): Uploading redline now. Expect a short comment list and suggested fallback: CRO sign authority for exceptions.
sam (AE): Thanks. I'll tell Vertex we can spin up masked sandbox within 48h after OF countersigned with conditional clause. Closing loop in 1h. :white_check_mark:
